sections.about: Hi! My names Aaron and I'm an electrical engineering student. From an early age, my passion for engineering new things has been a driving force. Immersed in the world of coding, I crafted my skills and discovered innovative solutions. I am currently studying my Bachelor's Degree of Science in Electrical Engineering at the University of Calgary.
sections.projects: Here's some projects I've worked on, ranging from AI/ML to Web Development.
sections.experience: Here's some of my past experiences.

experiences.title: Scholar, 16th Cohort
d: Selected to join the 16th cohort of Scholars Academy, a leadership-focused undergraduate community supporting students with strong curiosity, initiative, and commitment to impact.
Engage in mentorship, individualized advising, service-learning, retreats, and skill-building programs designed to support scholarship preparation, graduate school readiness, and leadership growth.

experiences.title: Machine Learning Researcher
experiences.location: Machine Intelligence and Reasoning Lab @ University of Calgary
d: Conducting machine learning research at the University of Calgary focused on fine-tuning large language models, improving model performance, and adapting LLMs for specialized research and simulation tasks.
Developing agentic AI simulators and ML-driven workflows to explore autonomous decision-making, multi-agent behavior, and practical applications of advanced AI systems.

experiences.title: Simulations & Modelling Team Member
experiences.location: Student Organization for Aerospace Research @ UofC
d: Utilized computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and flight simulation tools to model rocket trajectories, aerodynamic profiles, and propulsion dynamics, enhancing launch prediction accuracy.
Collaborated with a cross-disciplinary team of mechanical, electrical, and propulsion engineers to integrate simulation data into the design pipeline.

experiences.title: Project Manager of Instruction
d: Directed a team of 12+ volunteers and instructors to deliver STEAM-based educational programs to youth from low socioeconomic backgrounds across Calgary.
Managed curriculum development for hands-on science, technology, engineering, art, and mathematics (STEAM) activities to foster curiosity, innovation, and problem-solving skills.
Coordinated a cross-functional team of instructors and volunteers to deliver engaging workshops and educational materials to over 200+ students.

experiences.title: Resarch Intern
experiences.location: Laboratory of Interfacial Science and Advanced Materials @ University of Calgary
d: Gained expertise in electrospinning and 3D bioprinting for advanced material development, including optimization of process parameters.
Critically reviewed and contributed to 2 peer-reviewed research articles and participated in weekly team meetings to strengthen collaboration and presentation skills.

experiences.title: Guitar Teacher
d: Provided personalized 1-on-1 guitar instruction to 30+ students of various skill levels, resulting in a 30% increase in student retention and satisfaction
Mentored students in improvisation skills, resulting in an increase of students' confidence and creativity in playing the guitar

experiences.title: Software Developer
d: Collaborated with a team of other enthusiastic students to develop and launch a full-stack real-time voting application using PostgreSQL, React, and Node.js
Led backend development team, collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate new API features.

projects.title: Wall-E Inspired RC Car
projects.d: An award-winning Wall-E inspired remote-controlled car featuring custom PCB design, embedded firmware, telemetry, motor control, and 3D-printed mechanical systems.
projects.exd: Led project management while contributing to the cars power supply and motor-control PCB, STM32 firmware, Bluetooth telemetry, ultrasonic sensing, and full system integration. Earned the ENEL300 Ingenuity Award and placed 4th in the timed challenge.

projects.title: PrecisionFit
projects.d: An AI-driven personal trainer application using computer vision and neural networks.
projects.exd: Computer webcam analyses workout data, outputting accuracy metrics to help improve exercise form.

projects.title: CashCorn
projects.d: A Chrome extension designed to curb impulsive online spending by prompting users to reflect before purchases.
projects.exd: It detects when you're making an impulsive buy, and stops you in your tracks by forcing you to play and reflect on if you truly need the product and showing you the common risks associated with it. Won Tier 2 - Third Place in the CalgaryHacks 2025.
